title: plasmashell crashes in AppMenuModel::removeSearchActionsFromMenu after the app rebuilds a submenu while Global Menu search has results
line: Typing in the Global Menu's search no longer crashes Plasma after the app has rebuilt one of its menus.
explanation: The Global Menu search added matching app actions to its popup and kept raw pointers to them so it could remove them on the next keystroke. When the app rebuilt a submenu, the menu importer deleted those actions, and the next text change (or switching windows, which clears the field) called removeAction() on freed memory and crashed plasmashell. The list now holds QPointers, so deleted actions are skipped, and Return only triggers a result that still exists.

commits.message:
applets/appmenu: Don't crash when search results are deleted

The search kept raw pointers to the actions it listed as results, so when
the app rebuilt one of its submenus the next change of the search text
removed the deleted actions again and crashed. Hold them as QPointer.

BUG: 526561

media.caption: Master: search 'app' lists the Dynamic menu's items; the app rebuilds the menu and the results vanish; typing 'l' crashes plasmashell (panel gone).
Master: same steps, plasmashell crashes on the next keystroke.
With the fix: same steps, the results vanish on the rebuild and typing 'l' keeps the panel and search open.
With the fix: same steps plus more typing and Return, no crash.

review.text: Holding m_currentSearchActions as QList<QPointer<QAction>> and skipping null pointers in returnPressed cleanly fixes the use-after-free crash when an application rebuilds a submenu while Global Menu search results are active. QWidget::removeAction(nullptr) is a safe no-op (an explicit `if (action)` guard would be a minor readability improvement, not a blocker), and the fix is thoroughly verified against both reported crash paths.
